title: Absorbing copy-return control
statement: For every Boolean input word $x$ and every configuration $c$ of the input copier on $x$, if $c$ is in state $2$, then one machine step leaves the entire configuration unchanged.
hypotheses_covered: $c$ is a configuration of the input copier on $x$
replaced: Every input-copier configuration in the return control is left entirely unchanged by one step, so the return can be used at its first visit.
